content.comment_body: Hello, I have a project where I need to assemble several base units using [product_name] modules and other components. Each base unit will be housed in a compact enclosure. A few units require an external display since their installed location will be out of sight. I intended to use a separate [product_name] operator device, installed in its own enclosure, to address this need. My client prefers that all the base units (with the specific modules) are identical, so I need to install the [product_name] operator device in every unit. However, at the moment, I can only find the cable sold as part of the complete operator device kit. Is it possible to buy the cable separately in the UK? If so, where? Thank you for your assistance.

Hello, My [company_name] representative mentioned the operator device cable is typically included with the operator device package, but it can be ordered individually. You may want to contact your [company_name] supplier for details. Regards
I’ve received a quote from [company_name] for just the operator device cable assembly. Thanks for your support.
Once you obtain the cable, please let us know the ordering code (just for the cable itself). I have a similar need for two units.
Details from the quote: Part no: [article_no] Description: [product_name] operator device cable, spare part for [product_name] operator device, length 2.5 meters

Hi, I'm dealing with a similar scenario and want to expand the question. I also require the plastic cover that conceals the cable entry on the left side of the [product_name] base module. While it's part of the operator device package, I'm wondering if it can be ordered separately as a spare part. Can anyone confirm if this is possible? Thanks! [user_name]
A new topic was opened by [user_name] in a separate thread regarding the operator device cable 10m. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking ways to purchase specific hardware components for their [company_name] modular systems, especially the operator device cable and accompanying plastic covers. The main issue is the limited availability of these parts individually, as they are often bundled in complete sets. Users depend on [company_name] partners or representatives to confirm if spare parts can be sourced separately, which creates uncertainty and complicates assembly consistency across units. The thread reflects practical concerns with sourcing individual accessories and how this affects uniform installation and user satisfaction.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to order the operator device cable and related accessories individually, wishing for straightforward sourcing and compatibility across units. They look for clear information about part availability so they can assemble identical units without complication.
